note: név = name → nevem = my name (the é shortens before -em). The blank is your name with no ending. Alternative: ___ vagyok. = I am ___.
éves = years old; vagyok = I am. The blank is a number word with no ending, e.g. huszonegy éves vagyok (21). Inside a number 2 is két, not kettő: huszonkét éves.
születési hely = place of birth; helyem = my place. The blank is the town's name with no ending (A születési helyem Rockford.).

születtem = I was born. The year takes -ban or -ben by its last number word: -ban after …háromban, …hatban, …nyolcban, …húszban; -ben after …egyben, …kettőben, …négyben, …ötben, …hétben, …kilencben, …tízben, …kétezerben, …kilencvenben. Examples: kétezer-ötben (2005), kétezer-hatban (2006), ezerkilencszázkilencvenben (1990). Written with digits: 2005-ben.
állampolgár = citizen (állam = state + polgár = citizen). Nationality words are lowercase: amerikai, magyar. No blank.

gloss: I live in the state of ___, in the United States.
note: állam = state → államban = in the state; lakom = I live. The blank is the state's English name with no ending (Illinois államban lakom). Egyesült Államok = United States.
édesanya = mother (the respectful word used in official settings; anya is the everyday word) → édesanyám = my mother; neve = his/her name. The blank is the name with no ending.
édesapa = father (respectful) → édesapám = my father. Same pattern as the mother frame: X neve = X's name. The blank is the name with no ending.
nagyapa = grandfather → nagyapám = my grandfather. For a grandmother: A nagymamám neve ___. The blank is the name with no ending.

gloss: My great-grandfather was born in Hungary.
note: dédnagyapa = great-grandfather → dédnagyapám = my great-grandfather; Magyarországon = in Hungary (Hungary takes the -on ending); született = was born. No blank.

gloss: My great-grandfather's place of birth is ___.
note: születési helye = his place of birth (-e = his/her). Put the Hungarian town's name in the blank with no ending (… születési helye Debrecen.).

text: Magyar állampolgár szeretnék lenni, mert a családom magyar származású.
gloss: I would like to become a Hungarian citizen, because my family is of Hungarian descent.
note: szeretnék lenni = I would like to be; mert = because; családom = my family; magyar származású = of Hungarian origin. No blank.

gloss: I have been learning Hungarian for ___ months.
note: hónapja = for … months (for years say éve: két éve); tanulok = I learn; magyarul = (in) Hungarian. The blank is a number word with no ending: két, három, hat.
foglalkozás = occupation → foglalkozásom = my occupation. The blank is a job noun with no ending, e.g. munkás (worker), mérnök (engineer), tanár (teacher).

testvér = sibling (brother or sister) → testvérem = my sibling. More specific: a bátyám (my older brother), a nővérem (my older sister), az öcsém (my younger brother), a húgom (my younger sister). The blank is the name with no ending.
